subject.title: fix(teams-meetings): join and transcribe live meetings reliably

question: Should the shared meeting-browser Plugin SDK require `meetingUrl` immediately, or should this branch add it compatibly for existing adapter implementations?
rationale: The change affects the exported adapter contract rather than only the bundled Teams implementation; choosing an immediate break versus an additive transition is an ownership and compatibility decision.

options.title: Add an additive compatibility path
options.body: Keep existing permission-plan adapters working while exposing meeting URL/origin to adapters that opt into the new capability.

options.title: Approve a breaking SDK transition
options.body: Accept the required parameter only with an explicit external-plugin migration, compatibility notice, and release ownership.

options.title: Pause the shared API change
options.body: Keep the Teams validation work separate until the Plugin SDK direction is agreed.

recommendation.title: Add an additive compatibility path
recommendation.body: Keep existing permission-plan adapters working while exposing meeting URL/origin to adapters that opt into the new capability.

likelyOwner.reason: The related merged Teams implementation and this follow-up establish the concrete shared adapter surface affected by the choice.
